holidays.law: ustawa z dnia 18 stycznia 1951 r. o dniach wolnych od pracy, art. 1 (t.j. Dz.U. 2025 poz. 296); 24 December added by Dz.U. 2024 poz. 1965 from 1 February 2025

administrative.title: Administrative proceedings
administrative.met_by: posting at a Polish post office of the designated operator, or electronic submission, before the end of the last day (KPA art. 57 § 5)

tax.title: Tax proceedings and tax payments
tax.met_by: posting at a Polish post office of the designated operator, or electronic submission, before the end of the last day (Ordynacja podatkowa art. 12 § 6); a tax paid by bank transfer counts on the day the payer's account is debited (Ordynacja podatkowa art. 60 § 1 pkt 2)

civil.title: Civil law and contracts
civil.met_by: the statement reaching the other party so that it could read it (Kodeks cywilny art. 61); allow delivery time

court.title: Civil court proceedings
court.law: KPC art. 165 § 1 with Kodeks cywilny art. 111, 112, 115
court.met_by: posting at a Polish post office of the designated operator before the end of the last day (KPC art. 165 § 2)

calendar.title: Plain calendar arithmetic, no statutory roll

deemed_delivery.title: Registered letter from an office or a tax office, not collected after notice (awizo)
deemed_delivery.from: the day the first notice was left
deemed_delivery.note: Counts as delivered on the last day of the 14-day collection period. The response window starts from that day.

deemed_delivery.title: Registered letter from a court, not collected after two notices
deemed_delivery.from: the day the first notice was left
deemed_delivery.law: KPC art. 139 § 1; court delivery regulation (Dz.U. 2024 poz. 19) § 6 to § 8; Supreme Court IV CKN 1026/00
deemed_delivery.note: Each notice gives 7 days counted from the day after it; the letter counts as delivered on the last day of the second period, usually 15 days after the first notice (7 days after the second notice when its date is known). A first letter to a private defendant may be served by a bailiff (KPC art. 139¹ § 1); if the claimant proves the address, the original date stands (art. 139¹ § 3). An electronic payment order counts as served at the PESEL-register address (KPC art. 505³⁴).

deemed_delivery.title: Message from a public body in the e-Doręczenia box, not opened
deemed_delivery.from: the day the message reached the delivery box
deemed_delivery.law: ustawa o doręczeniach elektronicznych art. 41 ust. 1 pkt 3, art. 42 ust. 2
deemed_delivery.note: Counts as delivered on the day after the 14 days that start when it reached the box. Opened earlier means delivered on the day of opening.

response_windows.title: Appeal against an administrative decision (odwołanie)
response_windows.from: delivery or announcement of the decision

response_windows.title: Complaint against an administrative ruling (zażalenie na postanowienie)
response_windows.from: delivery or announcement of the ruling

response_windows.title: Objection (sprzeciw) to a payment order in summary proceedings, delivered in Poland
Objection (sprzeciw) to an electronic payment order (EPU, e-sąd)
Pleas (zarzuty) against a payment order in writ proceedings (postępowanie nakazowe), delivered in the EU
Paying a fine issued on a ticket (mandat kredytowany)
response_windows.law: Kodeks postępowania w sprawach o wykroczenia art. 98 § 3

response_windows.title: Withdrawal from a distance or off-premises contract
response_windows.from: taking possession of the goods, or concluding the contract for services
response_windows.law: ustawa o prawach konsumenta art. 27 ust. 1, art. 28, art. 30 ust. 2 (sending the statement in time is enough)

response_windows.title: Withdrawal from a contract made during an unarranged visit by the trader at home or during an excursion
response_windows.from: taking possession of the goods, or concluding the contract for services
response_windows.law: ustawa o prawach konsumenta art. 27 ust. 2, art. 28, art. 30 ust. 2

response_windows.title: Trader's reply to a consumer complaint (reklamacja); no reply in time means the complaint is accepted
response_windows.law: ustawa o prawach konsumenta art. 7a ust. 1 and 2

recurring.title: Annual income tax return (PIT) for the previous year
recurring.applies_when: an adult had taxable income last year
recurring.law: ustawa o podatku dochodowym od osób fizycznych art. 45 ust. 1

recurring.title: Property tax instalment (podatek od nieruchomości); a yearly amount up to PLN 100 is paid once, by 15 March
recurring.applies_when: the household owns a home, land or a garage
recurring.law: ustawa o podatkach i opłatach lokalnych art. 6 ust. 7 and 11a

recurring.title: 800+ child benefit application for the period from 1 June (filed by 30 April: paid without a gap from June)
recurring.applies_when: the household has a child under 18 and receives or wants 800+
recurring.law: ustawa o pomocy państwa w wychowywaniu dzieci art. 13 ust. 5, art. 18 ust. 1 and 2, art. 21 ust. 3 and 4
